summary.candidate_filter: third-party ProxyIP only; Cloudflare official IP ranges excluded; IPv4 only; text/domain sources, manual allowlist and denylist supported; target exit region enforced
summary.selection_policy: single stable current IP; keep while healthy and still in target region; fail over only after consecutive validation failures
summary.ranking: four stages (local RTT/jitter, rolling stability, throughput, local probe overlay): quality gate first (bot score >= min, target region, no corporateProxy/verifiedBot, third-party verification, local handshake latency <= max, jitter <= max, enough probe samples, 7d success rate), then effective latency = blended local P50 + jitter weight + stability penalty + transfer time of a fixed payload; bot score only breaks ties inside the gate
summary.latency_metric: local TCP+TLS handshake P50 in ms; third-party checker round trip kept as api_latency_ms; measured download throughput folded in as transfer time

throughput.policy: cheap RTT screens candidates down to top N, then a real download through the ProxyIP supplies the transfer-time term; a fast handshake with a slow pipe loses
